title: trifolium squamosum subsp. xatardii
intro: Trifolium squamosum subsp. xatardii, commonly known as Xatard's clover, is a sub-species of clover plant that belongs to the family Fabaceae. Xatard's clover is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support digestive health and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Xatard's clover are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. While more research is needed to fully understand its effects, Xatard's clover may have potential applications in traditional medicine for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
